mitigation_descriptions: Ensure permissions on /etc/shadow and sensitive credential stores are properly restricted to root only.
Restrict sudo permissions and manage privileged access to prevent unauthorized users from reading credential files.
Enforce strong password hashing algorithms and require credential resets if hashes are potentially compromised.
reasoning: The alert sequence confirms credential dumping via T1003.008 where account phopkins used sudo to read /etc/shadow on intranet-server. Immediate containment and credential rotation are required due to potential exposure of system password hashes.
remediation_plan: 1. Isolate host intranet-server (10.35.35.206) from the network to prevent potential lateral movement. 2. Suspend or revoke active sessions for user phopkins and force a password reset. 3. Initiate a mandatory password reset for all user accounts listed in /etc/shadow. 4. Audit /etc/sudoers on intranet-server to restrict non-administrative users from executing commands that access sensitive files. 5. Inspect authentication and network logs on intranet-server for signs of credential exfiltration or subsequent unauthorized access.
